system.longDesc:
Area of Effect 5 Meters/15 Meters

Instead of dealing their blast damage, flash grenades create a bright flash, inflicting the Blinded condition on anyone in line-of-sight within a 15-meter radius who looked in the direction of the explosion. The condition goes away after 2d6 rounds.

Thrown: short range 4 m, long range 8 m (Accuracy (Throwing) test, TN 11).
